infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BuildDesk needs camera access to capture photos of job sites, equipment, and documentation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BuildDesk needs photo library access to attach photos to projects and reports.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: BuildDesk needs permission to save photos to your library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BuildDesk needs location access to track time at job sites and provide GPS-based features.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BuildDesk needs continuous location access for automatic geofencing clock-in/out and background time tracking at job sites.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: BuildDesk needs background location access for geofencing and automatic time tracking at job sites.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BuildDesk needs microphone access for voice notes and job site documentation.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: BuildDesk needs contacts access to help you manage your team and client information.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: BuildDesk needs calendar access to sync your project schedules.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: BuildDesk uses Face ID for secure and quick authentication.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: BuildDesk uses speech recognition for voice commands and notes.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: BuildDesk uses anonymous usage data to improve the app experience. No personal data is shared with third parties.
